Frequently asked questions

Good to know.

Can I change computers?＋

Yes. Manage registered devices in your account portal. The number of registered devices depends on your plan.

Can I use SpotScout on two computers?＋

Individual licenses allow one active device at a time. Scout Lab can register up to two devices, but only one may be active at once.

What does Lifetime mean?＋

Lifetime is a one-time license for the SpotScout plan purchased. Update and support terms will be confirmed before launch.

Are updates included?＋

Update coverage is being finalized. The final license terms will be shown before purchase.

Can teams share one account?＋

No. Team plans use seat-based access. Each user signs in with their own account.

What happens when my annual plan expires?＋

Your subscription status and access options will appear in your account portal. You can renew or review your plan there.

Questions about scouting services? ↗

Common questions

Quick answers.

What does SpotScout run on?＋

SpotScout is a Windows desktop application. The website helps with product information, learning, account management and support.

Can I download before signing in?＋

Downloads will require a SpotScout account and an active license. Account, payment and download checks are not connected yet, and no installer is currently available.

How do team licenses work?＋

Team plans use seats with a separate SpotScout account for each user. Team members can work at the same time.

Can I send a match for analysis?＋

The scouting service page shows the intended request flow. Video transfer and order placement are not connected in this prototype.
